logline: When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.
continuity: Follows Episode 6, where Juliana found refuge and warmth beside the hearth with her mysterious husband; morning brings unwelcome visitors from her former life to their humble doorstep.

events.text: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the cold, damp ground outside the stone cottage, pulling weeds from the dirt with her bare hands.
Juliana, dressed in her simple grey long-sleeved gown, works tirelessly with soil caked beneath her fingernails.
Low-angle tracking shot as an ornate black-and-gold carriage with crest emblazoned on the door rolls to a stop on the muddy path outside the gate.
Heavy carriage wheels grinding in mud, horse snorts, and rhythmic hoofbeats halting.
Medium shot as Aristocratic Woman steps out of the carriage into the misty air, shielding herself under an intricate lace parasol in an elegant lavender gown.
Gerald steps down from the carriage behind her, looking immaculate in a high-collared navy frock coat, white waistcoat, and dark cravat.
Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.
Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.

events.speaker: Aristocratic Woman
events.text: This is where you live now?
Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier.
Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: You came all this way just to insult my home?
Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.

events.speaker: Aristocratic Woman
events.text: Home? Look at your hands, Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.

events.speaker: Aristocratic Woman
events.text: You look like a servant.
Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.
Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: I work with my hands. There is no shame in that.
Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: You were born a lady.
Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: And I remain one.
Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort.
Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away.
Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: You have no authority here. Leave.
Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: And your husband?
Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: Where is that beggar husband?
The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.

events.speaker: Aristocratic Woman
events.text: Gerald, don't let him frighten you.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: What are you staring at?
Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.

events.speaker: Gerald
events.text: We are leaving.
Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.

events.speaker: Aristocratic Woman
events.text: Leaving? Gerald!
Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
Carriage door slamming shut.
Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.
Medium profile two-shot of Juliana turning toward the Scarred Bearded Man, her eyes gleaming with genuine admiration.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: You didn't say a word.
Close-up on the Scarred Bearded Man looking down at her, his rugged features softening with quiet affection.

events.speaker: Scarred Bearded Man
events.text: I didn't need to.
Medium shot as the Scarred Bearded Man stoops down, scoops up the heavy bundle of firewood in one arm, and walks calmly past Juliana toward their door.
Close-up of Juliana looking after him, a radiant and grateful smile blooming across her face as the scene fades out.
